![](/images/uq1.jpg){width="100%"}

LADAL tools are self-contained Shiny applications that run in your browser — no installation of R or any other software is required. Simply click a launch button below, wait for the environment to load (typically 1–2 minutes on first launch), and start working with your own texts.

```{=html}
<div class="launch-info">
  <div class="launch-option recommended">
    <div class="lo-label">⭐ Recommended</div>
    <h4>ARDC BinderHub</h4>
    <p>Hosted by the <a href="https://ardc.edu.au/services/ardc-nectar-research-cloud/ardc-binderhub-service/">Australian Research Data Commons</a>. More generous computing resources and faster load times. Requires authentication through an Australian or New Zealand research organisation covered by the <a href="https://aaf.edu.au/">AAF</a> or <a href="https://www.reannz.co.nz/products-and-services/tuakiri">Tuakiri</a>.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="launch-option open">
    <div class="lo-label">Open access</div>
    <h4>mybinder.org</h4>
    <p>Free and open — no account or institutional login required. Suitable for users outside Australia/New Zealand or without AAF/Tuakiri access. May have lower resource limits and slower load times.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```
